story.title: Krutrim's Bhashik Brings AI Voice Intelligence to 22 Indian Languages — Targets 500 Million Non-English Speakers
story.summary: Krutrim, India's first AI unicorn backed by Ola founder Bhavish Aggarwal, has deployed Bhashik — a natively multilingual AI product targeting the 500 million Indians who conduct their daily lives entirely in regional languages. Krutrim-2, the underlying model trained on over 2 trillion tokens, supports 22 Indian languages with a 128K context window and powers Bhashik's vernacular speech products and Document Intelligence Service for enterprise document processing in local languages. The strategic bet is straightforward: the next billion AI users will not use AI in English. The company that owns native-language AI for India owns the largest untapped AI market in the world.
